observations: The page number «80» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L08 end chapters 30 and 30a (pp. 78-79, JP2 0110-0111). L09-L10: the heading of the tables of the equation of time, in bold, centred, with the reference to the tables below it, not to a chapter of the text (L11-L13).

L01-L02: «stupor», Adelard's word for buht, the daily true motion (p. 78, JP2 0110, L09-L13). N01: Ovid, Metamorphoses IV 461 (Ixion's wheel stood still) and «stupuerunt verba palato», words stuck to the palate; the italics as printed. L07: the sixth and seventh columns of Tables 61-66, the first and the second half of the «rota draconis», taken up at the end of chapter 33.

L22-L31. Checked: al-Battānī's 7° 54′ of the equator are 31m 36s of time (4 minutes to a degree); 14m 31s + 16m 18s = 30m 49s, which is nearer to al-Battānī's 31m 36s than to al-Khwārizmī's 34m 28s, as L30-L31 say. The modern values: in 1914 the equation of time (mean less apparent time) was +14m 27s on 12 February and reached its other extreme, −16m 24s, on 3-4 November; on 18 November it was −14m 53s, so that the date of L29 does not agree with the value given there. The values of Tables 67 and 68 and Ptolemy's 33m 30s (L33) are to be compared with the tables and the Almagest.

L22-L33: «34m 28s» and the other times with the m and the s raised, written with a space between the minutes and the seconds; L28 «+ 14m 31s» and L29 «— 16m 18s», the signs with a gap of 13 px before the figures, the minus a long dash. L22, L23, L25: «22.°», «18.°», «19.°», «9.°», «10.°», the degree sign after the point of the ordinal.

L14: «nychthemerōn» with the macron over the o, in italics with «Aequatio» (L13). Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Athelhard», «Batt.», «Kh.», «Ptol.», «Ovid», «Georges», «Nallino», «Schiaparelli», «Burgess»; italics: «stupor,», «buht», the headings of the columns (L07), «Aequatio nychthemerōn», «Zeitgleichung» (L16, L20), «wahrer», «mittlerer», «subtrahiert», «Beispiel :», «Null,», «Maximum», «Sūrya-Siddhānta», the Latin of N01.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (9-14 px measured).
